lines.text: Google announced a safe room for AI agents, where the agent never holds your passwords.
Each agent runs in a microVM, a tiny isolated virtual computer walled off from the others.
lines.title: The microVM

lines.text: The agent's brain runs outside the box and only sends commands in. The sandbox sends results back.
lines.title: Brain and hands

lines.text: Passwords stay outside. A gateway adds them to requests, so the agent never sees them.
lines.title: Secrets stay out

lines.text: So even a confused agent cannot leak what it never had.
lines.title: Why it helps

lines.text: It is not available yet. Google plans a preview in the coming months, with no price announced.
lines.title: Status
